in_marathi.name: Geet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit word 'Geeta' meaning 'song' or 'melody'. In Hindu mythology, the Bhagavad Gita is considered a sacred song of Lord Krishna to Arjuna, imparting moral and ethical wisdom.
